objective: Restore the measured INT8 regression on domain-independent two-hop reasoning without changing neural weights, importing facts, or reducing CPU throughput.

controlling_evidence.measured_regression: domain_independent_reasoning fell from 0.86 to 0.70 while routing stayed 1.0 and collapse stayed zero

candidate_lock.source_material: passing search records in the immutable cumulative acquisition bundle only
candidate_lock.accepted_scope: strict two-hop class chains whose premises, subject, and requested conclusion are wholly supplied in the prompt

decision_rule: Derive exactly one search-supported, teacher-free reasoning handler. Reject if it accepts inconsistent chains, changes any unknown-prompt output, or fails any quality, identity, sparsity, speed, TTFT, RSS, or final gate.
claim_boundary: This is a bounded prompt-supplied transitive reasoner, not a claim of general theorem proving, teacher equivalence, or retained world knowledge.
